text: Auchan is a family-controlled French retail group: the Association familiale Mulliez (AFM) is its principal shareholder and Gérard Mulliez personally the second, with employees holding the remaining 13.5% via Valauchan; the operating company Auchan Retail International sits under the holding ELO (ex Auchan Holding) with Financière de Participations at 70%, Soparsam 15% and employee-held Valauchan 15%.
short: Auchan is controlled by the Mulliez family (AFM), with 13.5% held by employees.
